title: Sagaleewwan Bishaan Tasgabbaa'aa Cinaa
intro: Hawaasa magaalaa ykn bulchaa tokkoof osoo hin taane, bishaan tasgabbaa’aa jireenyi naannoo isaa walitti qabameef moggaafame tokko yaadi. Hawaasa kana kan yaadatu keeyyattoonni muraasni qofti, yeroo hundumaa warra qajeelfama didan keessaa kan tarreeffaman. Yeroo isaan dukkana irraa dubbatan dhaggeeffadhaa.
clues: Nuti hawaasa Qur'aana keessatti moggaafamedha, ammas seenaan keenya guutuun iccitii keessatti haguugamee jira.
Yeroo hunda warra gane cinatti akka namoota Ad fi Thamud kaafamna.
Sahaaba Ar-Raas, Boolla jireenyi keenya itti hidhame jedhamna.
Ergamaa qajeelfama ifa ta'een nuuf ergame gane.
Warra ergamtoota Rabbiin erge hunda didan keessaa lakkaa'amna.
Dorsiisni ganuu nu dura jiru hunda irratti raawwatame, diduu keenyaaf badiisa nu mudate.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Bakka Muusaan hin jirretti re'ee warqee waaqeffate
Inaaffaa irraa kan ka'e Yuusuf ajjeesuuf shira xaxe

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Holqa keessa jaarraa hedduuf akka ciisan kan hojjetame

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
